verdict.rationale: Braintrust instrumentation captures token usage, latency, and metadata for every request, and the Logs page provides a searchable/filterable table of traces (docs-1, docs-15, docs-37), which implies per-request cost/token visibility. However, no evidence explicitly shows dashboards aggregating cost/token usage by model or over time periods — missing for 10: explicit cost-per-model dashboard, time-series token/cost charts, and independent corroboration that dashboards surface this breakdown.
